description_sq:
Ofrojme per shitje apartament te tipologjise 3+1+2 ne kompleksin E-88 ne rrugen Dritan Hoxha.
Apartamenti ka nje siperfaqe totale 144 m2 dhe pozicionohet ne katin e 8 dhe te fundit ne nje godine te sapoperfunduar.
Organizimi:
-Korridor shperndares
-Sallon i bollshem sebashku me ambientin e ngrenies
-3 dhoma gjumi
-2 tualate
-2 ballkone
Ka orientim te lire jug lindje me ndricim natyral gjate gjithe dites.
Mundesi blerje parkimi me cmim extra.
Me kontaktoni per nje vizite ne prone
description_en: We offer for sale a 3+1+2 typology apartment in the E-88 complex on Dritan Hoxha Street. The apartment has a total area of ​​144 m2 and is located on the 8th and last floor of a newly completed building. Organization: - Distribution corridor - Spacious living room with dining area - 3 bedrooms - 2 toilets - 2 balconies It has a free south-east orientation with natural lighting throughout the day. Possibility to purchase parking at an extra price. Contact me for a visit to the property
